3.3.1.2-f111.accuracy_reason: Macrobius, Sat. 2.5.10 gives the saying to Julia, the daughter of Augustus, in the first person.

3.3.1.2-f12.accuracy_reason: It renders Mimnermus fr. 1 ('hateful to boys, despised by women') about old age.

3.3.1.2-f21.accuracy_reason: Panegyricus 83 reads 'ita foris claros domestica destruebat infamia', in a passage about wives.

3.3.1.2-f26.accuracy_reason: Florida 3 has Marsyas mocking Apollo as 'genis gratum, corpore glabellum, arte multiscium, fortuna opulentum'; the attribution is suitably hedged.

3.3.1.2-f27.accuracy_reason: The Institutes 1.1.3 give the three precepts, and Q. Mucius Scaevola and Trebatius were Roman jurists; the remark on 'eam' is offered as interpretation.

3.3.1.2-f33.accuracy_reason: The line is Heroides 16.288 (Paris to Helen).

3.3.1.2-f50.accuracy_reason: Thyestes 217–218 reads 'sanctitas pietas fides / privata bona sunt'.

3.3.1.2-f53.accuracy_reason: Suetonius, Divus Julius 51 records the soldiers' verse at the Gallic triumph.

3.3.1.2-f54.accuracy_reason: Divus Julius 52 has the elder Curio's 'omnium mulierum virum et omnium virorum mulierem'.

3.3.1.2-f6.accuracy_reason: Ars Amatoria 2.373ff. reads 'nec lea' and builds up to the woman who catches a rival in her bed.

3.3.1.2-f60.accuracy_reason: Aen. 3.490: Andromache, looking at Ascanius, says Astyanax had such eyes, hands and face. The words do describe her dead son.

3.3.1.2-f61.accuracy_reason: Aen. 4.11, Dido to Anna about Aeneas; reading armis as armus 'shoulders' is the usual reading, going back to Servius.

3.3.1.2-f73.accuracy_reason: Juvenal 6.652–4: wives watch Alcestis die in her husband's place, and the standard text reads cupiant.

3.3.1.2-f8.accuracy_reason: The Lycoris elegies printed under Cornelius Gallus's name (Gauricus, 1501) are by Maximianus, and imbellis in an erotic sense is well attested.

3.3.1.2-f81.accuracy_reason: Euripides, Andromache 944–6: Hermione blames the women who visited her.

3.3.1.2-f82.accuracy_reason: Martial 1.62: Laevina, chaste as a Sabine, goes to Baiae, falls for a young man and leaves her husband.
